page: Amazon Web Services r7i.48xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor. It features 192 vCPUs and 96 physical cores with 2 threads per core, utilizing dedicated Intel Xeon 8488C processors running at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The system architecture is x86_64 and includes 1536.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 5 GHz, which provides 8.0 GB of memory per physical core. This instance does not include local storage or GPUs, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 50 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance in multi-core CPU execution, passmark CPU tests, and memory bandwidth across both small and large blocks. The Intel Xeon processor supports advanced instruction sets including Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), which contribute to top-tier results in CPU encryption, physics, and ray tracing. Single-core performance is rated as average to strong, while database operations and Redis SET operations achieve top-tier throughput.

The instance offers high resource density for memory-bound workloads, though the lack of local NVMe storage requires network storage configuration. The qualitative cost efficiency is characterized by high memory capacity and memory bandwidth per vCPU, making it suitable for large-scale database operations, memory-intensive applications, and multi-threaded CPU tasks. It is also capable of handling medium to large LLM inference tasks, showing strong performance in prompt processing.
